description: Create a list. To set up several lists with indexes and rules, a schema sync document (plan_schema_sync, apply_schema_sync) is usually better. Rules that don't compile, or whose tests fail, refuse the whole create, with diagnostics in details. 1 request.

activated.description: Deactivated lists are invisible to tokens

indexable.description: Allow listing and searching its items with a token. A new list is not indexable unless this is set

pathName.description: A unique name to use in URLs instead of the id (letters, digits, - and _)

protected.description: Refuse to delete the list while it has items

readonly.description: Refuse writes to the list, its items and indexes

realtime.description: Send realtime events for the list's changes

rules.description: Write rules, in the JSONPad rules language, checked on every item write made with an API token; null removes them. Check them first with the JSONPad docs server's check_write_rules

rulesTests.description: Tests the rules must pass before they're saved, or null for none

schema.description: A JSON schema every item's data must match, or null for none

tags.description: Tags (at most 20). Replaces the existing tags

name: create_list
title: Create a list
